_meta.purpose: Shell/CLI/Telegram user-facing strings. Web UI uses web/messages/{lang}.json (different schema).

welcome.assistente:
Hi! 👋

I'm the Job Hunter Team Assistant — your point of contact with the AI team that's about to start looking for jobs for you.

To get going I need to know you. Send me here on Telegram your CV (PDF, DOC, even a photo of the paper version works), or just tell me in a couple of lines what you're looking for — role, sector, city. From that I build the profile and the rest of the team gets to work for you.

A draft or rough notes are perfectly fine, no need to have anything polished. 📄 I start from what you have.
welcome.capitano:
I'm the Captain. 👨‍✈️

I coordinate the team that will work on your search: someone hunts positions, someone analyzes them, someone calculates the match against your profile, someone writes the CV tailored to each one, someone does the final review before applying.

For now I'll stay silent. As soon as your profile is ready I'll fire up the engine, and from there I'll write to you when I have something concrete: a batch of interesting positions, an application ready to review together, or a blocker worth flagging. Talk soon. 🎯
welcome.mentor:
I'm the Mentor. 🧙‍♂️

I take care of the big picture of your search: once a week I'll bring you a reading of the numbers — patterns that emerged, market signals, career choices worth considering. Measured voice, I'll only write when there's something that really deserves your attention.

For now I'm listening. When I have enough data to tell you something useful, I'll write. 📊

wizard.welcome_subtitle: Let's get your team ready in a few steps.
wizard.config_corrupt_body:
The config file exists but is not valid JSON.
It will be recreated from scratch.
wizard.cloud.login_body:
Open the browser on your computer and go to:

      https://jobhunterteam.ai

Log in with Google (or create the account if you don't have one).
Leave the page open — you'll need it in a moment for pairing.
wizard.cloud.pairing_body:
Now I'll launch the CLI ↔ web pairing.

You'll see a URL printed (jobhunterteam.ai/cli-link) and a code.
Open the URL in the same browser where you're logged in, type the
code, confirm. The wizard will proceed by itself as soon as the server
confirms the pairing.

If the page still asks for login → go to jobhunterteam.ai
and log in with Google first.
wizard.cloud.pairing_failed:
Cloud pairing failed. Check that the web deploy is OK and
that you're logged in on the browser. Retry: jht setup
wizard.profile.intro: First, your candidate profile. The AI team needs it to match positions and write CVs.
wizard.telegram.intro: We need 3 Telegram bots (Assistant, Captain, Mentor). Create them with @BotFather and paste the tokens.
wizard.provider.intro: Choose the AI provider that powers the team:
wizard.provider.install_failed_continue: CLI install failed. Save config anyway and handle it manually?
wizard.oauth.notify_body:
Now open another terminal on your computer, SSH into the VPS
(same ssh command you used at the start), and run:

      jht oauth-login

The %s TUI opens:
  1. open the URL printed in your browser
  2. log in with your %s account
  3. paste the code and when you see "authenticated" exit with /quit

I'm monitoring the filesystem: as soon as I detect the credentials
I'll proceed automatically. Nothing to press here.
wizard.oauth.aborted: Login not completed. When ready run: jht setup
wizard.workhours.hint: Distributes the weekly budget across the hours you choose. Skip for 24/7.
wizard.team.start_failed: Team start failed. See log above. Retry: jht team start
wizard.outro_done:
All set! The team is working.
  Status:  jht team status
  Logs:    jht logs --tail 30
  Stop:    jht team stop --all
wizard.outro_aborted: Setup aborted. Retry with: jht setup
wizard.start.done: Team is running. Check Telegram for the welcome messages.
